text: This report provides an annual update of the Investment Manager fees paid by the Toronto Investment Board ("Board") for the year ending December 31, 2023. The confidential attachment to this report provides a summary of the fees. All fees are in-line and in accordance with the amounts contracted with each Investment Manager.

The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 8, 2024) from the Director, Capital Markets remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains information that involves the security of property belonging to the City and the Toronto Investment Board.
